description_en: Retrieves the list of IA storage class files and subdirectories that contain IA storage class files under a specified directory in a General-purpose NAS file system
description_zh: 获取通用型NAS指定目录下的低频存储文件和包含低频存储文件的子目录列表
name: ListDirectoriesAndFiles

parameters.help_en:
The absolute path of the specified directory.

The path must start with a forward slash (/) and must be an existing path in the mount target
parameters.help_zh:
指定目录的绝对路径。

必须以正斜线（/）开头，并且是挂载点中真实存在的路径
parameters.name: path

parameters.help_en: The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. If the return results are truncated, you can use NextToken to initiate a new request to retrieve the content after the current truncation position
parameters.help_zh: 当请求的返回结果被截断时，您可以使用NextToken再次发起请求，获取从当前截断位置之后的内容
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en:
The storage class type.
InfrequentAccess: IA storage class.
Archive: Archive storage class.
All: queries data of all storage classes.
When StorageType is set to All, you must set DirectoryOnly to true
parameters.help_zh:
分级存储类型。
InfrequentAccess：低频存储。
Archive：归档存储。
All：查询所有存储数据。
当StorageType取值为ALL时，必须配置DirectoryOnly参数，且值为true
parameters.name: storage_type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to query only directories.

Valid values:

false (default): No. Both directories and files can be queried.
true: Yes. Only directories are queried.
When StorageType is set to All, DirectoryOnly must be set to true and cannot be set to false
parameters.help_zh:
是否只查询目录。

取值：

false（默认值）：否，可以查询目录或文件
true：是，只查询目录
当StorageType取值为All时，DirectoryOnly取值为true，不能为false
parameters.name: directory_only

parameters.help_en:
The number of directories or files included in each query result.

Valid values: 10 to 128.

Default value: 100
parameters.help_zh:
每次查询结果中包含的目录或文件的个数。

取值范围：10~128

默认值：100
parameters.name: max_results

Entries.description_en: The collection of directory or file information

items.description_en: The collection of directory or file information

Atime.description_en:
The query time.

The time follows the ISO 8601 standard and is returned in the format: `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ`.

This parameter is returned and meaningful only when Type is set to File
Atime.description_zh:
查询时间。

执行ISO8601标准表示，返回格式：`yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ`。

仅当Type为File时，返回该值且有意义

Ctime.description_en:
The time when the metadata was modified.

The time follows the ISO 8601 standard and is returned in the format: `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ`.

This parameter is returned and meaningful only when Type is set to File
Ctime.description_zh:
元数据修改时间。

执行ISO8601标准表示，返回格式：`yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ`。

仅当Type为File时，返回该值且有意义

FileId.description_en: The FileId of the directory or file

HasArchiveFile.description_en:
Indicates whether the directory contains archive storage class files.

This parameter is returned and meaningful only when Type is set to Directory.

Valid values:

true: The directory contains archive storage class files.
false: The directory does not contain archive storage class files
HasArchiveFile.description_zh:
是否包含归档存储文件。

仅当Type为Directory时，返回该值且有意义。

包括：

true：包含
false：不包含

HasInfrequentAccessFile.description_en:
Indicates whether the directory contains IA storage class files.

This parameter is returned and meaningful only when Type is set to Directory.

Valid values:

true: The directory contains IA storage class files.
false: The directory does not contain IA storage class files
HasInfrequentAccessFile.description_zh:
是否包含低频存储文件。

仅当Type为Directory时，返回该值且有意义。

包括：

true：包含
false：不包含

Inode.description_en: The inode of the file or directory

Mtime.description_en:
The time when the file was modified.

The time follows the ISO 8601 standard and is returned in the format: `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ`.

This parameter is returned and meaningful only when Type is set to File
Mtime.description_zh:
文件修改时间。

执行ISO8601标准表示，返回格式：`yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ`。

仅当Type为File时，返回该值且有意义

Name.description_en: The file name or directory name

OfflineDuration.description_en: The total duration for which the file has been stored as an archive file. Unit: seconds
OfflineDuration.description_zh: 转储为归档文件的总时长。单位：秒

OfflineUnchangedDuration.description_en: The total duration for which the file has remained unchanged since it was stored as an archive file. Unit: seconds
OfflineUnchangedDuration.description_zh: 转储为归档文件后文件距今未被改动的总时长。单位：秒

Owner.description_en:
The portable account ID.
This parameter is meaningful only when ProtocolType is set to SMB and access control is enabled
Owner.description_zh:
便携账号ID。
仅当ProtocolType=SMB且开启访问控制时，该返回值具有意义

RetrieveTime.description_en:
The time when the most recent data retrieval task was run.

The time follows the ISO 8601 standard and is returned in the format: `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ`.

This parameter is returned and meaningful only when Type is set to File
RetrieveTime.description_zh:
距现在最近一次数据取回任务执行的时间。

执行ISO8601标准表示，返回格式：`yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ`。

仅当Type为File时，返回该值且有意义

Size.description_en:
The size of the file.

Unit: bytes.

This parameter is returned and meaningful only when Type is set to File
Size.description_zh:
文件的大小。

单位：Byte（字节）

仅当Type为File时，返回该值且有意义

StorageType.description_en:
The storage class type of the returned file.

This parameter is returned and meaningful only when Type is set to File.

Valid values:
InfrequentAccess: IA storage class.
Archive: Archive storage class
StorageType.description_zh:
返回文件的分级存储类型。

仅当Type为File时，返回该值且有意义。

包括：
InfrequentAccess：低频存储。
Archive：归档存储

Type.description_en:
The type of the returned result.

Valid values:

File: file.
Directory: directory
Type.description_zh:
返回结果的类型。

包括：

File：文件
Directory：目录

NextToken.description_en: The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. If the return results are truncated, you can use NextToken to initiate a new request to retrieve the content after the current truncation position
NextToken.description_zh: 当请求的返回结果被截断时，您可以使用NextToken再次发起请求，获取从当前截断位置之后的内容
